response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, open-source contributions, and leadership in project development, but lacks explicit experience in IT architecture design, UML, and client-facing advisory roles, and his German proficiency is only basic — a critical requirement for this role.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience with modern technologies and open-source projects
Proven track record in leading technical initiatives and mentoring through workshops
Strong background in Linux, DevOps, and distributed systems with real-world scale
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, falling short of the required C1 level
No clear evidence of UML expertise, IT architecture design, or requirements management experience
Lacks documented experience in client advisory, technical assessment, or project leadership in IT consulting
